name: Metro

queries.query: Metro Lampung Indonesia official cadastral parcel map GIS land records BHUMI ATR/BPN
queries.result: First-party discovery identified BHUMI ATR/BPN, the official national interactive land map, and the official Kantor Pertanahan Kota Metro service page. BHUMI's current public configuration identifies a Bidang Tanah layer and its safe display fields, but no anonymous parcel feature response was retained.

queries.query: peta bidang tanah Kota Metro Lampung resmi ATR BPN BHUMI Kantor Pertanahan Kota Metro
queries.result: Hasil resmi menemukan BHUMI ATR/BPN sebagai peta interaktif pertanahan, Kantor Pertanahan Kota Metro as the local service custodian, and Tanah Harapan as the municipal thematic WebGIS. The municipal public map configuration exposed thematic layers but no cadastral parcel layer. No anonymous parcel geometry or native parcel identity was obtained.

registryEvidence.custodian: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Metro, Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang/Badan Pertanahan Nasional (ATR/BPN)
registryEvidence.scope: Local city land-office custodian for land registration, land rights, measurement, and land information services; BHUMI ATR/BPN is the official national public map presenting the local layer when available.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This evidences a local registry/service custodian and an official public map route, not successful anonymous citywide parcel geometry access.

parcelDiscovery.source: BHUMI ATR/BPN Bidang Tanah layer; municipal Tanah Harapan thematic WebGIS checked as a local alternative

fieldMapping.note: The configuration names NIB as a display field, but no parcel feature response or stable native identity was obtained, so no ID was promoted or retained.
